status: Recorded protocol only; external training and evaluation engines are not bundled

training.base_model: Vicuna-7B-v1.5 with the common LLaVA stage-1 projector

evaluation.MMBench: labeled dev; all option rotations; local circular accuracy
evaluation.AI2D: local exact multiple-choice accuracy on 3088 test questions
evaluation.POPE: official LLaVA scorer; macro average of random/popular/adversarial accuracy and precision
evaluation.ScienceQA: official image-bearing subset accuracy after valid choice-letter normalization
evaluation.OCRBench: local v1 case-insensitive answer-substring rule; raw count divided by ten

limitations: These parameters do not replace exact model, data, prompt, tokenizer and trainer version snapshots.
The public minimal experiment cannot regenerate the recorded benchmark table from scratch without external inputs and scorer integration.
No GPU launcher or server-specific GPU reservation process is distributed.
